findings.title: A check that reads plan documents goes red on main after a plan-only PR merges unchecked
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The cited filter, unfiltered push trigger and literal-path-only guard are as described, so a plan-only change read by an unguarded check would first fail on main after merge.

findings.title: EQL absorption plan drifts unguarded while release tooling still points operators to it
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The plan was removed from DOCS (so it escapes the iff and LIVE_VERDICT checks), yet release-gate.mjs:922-926 and release.yml:1026 still direct readers to it; the cited lines and the empty FROZEN_PUBLISHERS are accurate.

findings.title: Plan-only PRs stall if Test JS checks are or become required
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same conditional required-check mechanism as F-04; the cited filter and the test-eql.yml comment saying there is no required_status_checks rule are accurate.
